LESSON: KUSOMA 6.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA NOVELA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: USALAMA SHULENI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifun
Topic 6.2: Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza dhana za maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza dhana za maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza dhana za maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela.
4. Show that you can: kueleza dhana za maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza dhana za maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
